name: Abiy Ahmed
role: Prime Minister of Ethiopia; Prosperity Party chairman; secured a landslide re-mandate in the June 1, 2026 general election (438/486 seats) amid Tigray's exclusion and Amhara/Oromia disruptions
quote: It is only a matter of time before Ethiopia regains access to the port of Assab. Losing it after Eritrea's independence was a mistake.

name: Field Marshal Birhanu Jula
role: Chief of Staff, Ethiopian National Defense Force; oversaw the ENDF's response to the January Tselemt clashes, the March South Gondar counteroffensive, and the August Shererina engagement
quote: Officers must remain vigilant and prepared to confront those working against Ethiopia's strategic objectives and territorial integrity.

name: Debretsion Gebremichael
role: TPLF Chairman; sworn in as Tigray regional president on May 5, 2026 after the party reconstituted the pre-war regional council, directly challenging the federally-recognized interim administration
quote: The people of Tigray did not struggle for a temporary appointment from Addis Ababa.

name: Lt. Gen. Tadesse Worede
role: President, federally-recognized Tigray Interim Administration; his renewed federal mandate was the trigger cited by the TPLF for reconstituting a rival regional council
quote: Our withdrawal from Tselemti demonstrates readiness for dialogue and a peaceful resolution, not weakness.

name: Getachew Reda
role: Former interim president of the Tigray Interim Administration, deposed in the 2024/2025 TPLF factional dispute; remains a prominent voice critical of TPLF hardliners
quote: Power-hungry individuals within the TPLF are trying to drag Tigray into another war.

name: Isaias Afwerki
role: President of Eritrea; repeatedly warned in 2026 of Ethiopian war preparations tied to Red Sea port access, while pursuing closer ties with Egypt around Assab and Massawa
quote: Ethiopia's drive to secure access to a Red Sea port is the plan of a crazy person. Eritrea, though far smaller in population, will not be easily overpowered.

name: Zemene Kassie
role: Chairman, Amhara Fano National Movement (AFNM), unified January 17, 2026 from previously fragmented Fano commands; formerly led the Gojjam Fano command
quote: Unification of our forces under a single command is the only way to defend Amhara and force Addis Ababa to negotiate on our terms.

name: Eskinder Nega
role: Policy and Strategy director, Amhara Fano National Movement; previously led the Amhara People's Army faction before the January 2026 unification
quote: We remain open to genuine peace talks, but not while ENDF drone strikes continue to hit our communities.

name: Kumsa Diriba (Jaal Marroo)
role: Commander, Oromo Liberation Army (OLA); leads the insurgency from forest hideouts in Oromia and claimed a major operation near Addis Ababa in March 2026
quote: Our fight is against government forces, not against civilians. We are ending generations of oppression against the Oromo people.

name: Daniel Tamrat
role: District Governor, Raya Alamata (Tigray); reported the August 10, 2026 drone strike casualty figures that conflicted with Tigrayan military sources' account
quote: One civilian was killed and four others wounded. A river where people fetch water was also hit.

name: Kiros Hagos
role: Speaker, reconstituted Tigray State Council; elected alongside Debretsion Gebremichael on May 5, 2026 as part of the TPLF's parallel governance structure
quote: This council represents the sovereign will of the people of Tigray, not a body appointed from outside.

name: Amanuel Assefa
role: Deputy President and Justice Bureau head, TPLF-led Tigray council, appointed in the June 2026 executive restructuring
quote: Rebuilding Tigray's institutions on our own terms is essential after years of federal neglect of the Pretoria commitments.

name: Gedion Timothewos
role: Ethiopian federal official; authored the October 2025 letter to the UN Secretary-General alleging a coordinated 'Tsimdo' alliance between the TPLF and Eritrean government supporting the Fano offensive
quote: The evidence points to organized, cross-border support for armed groups seeking to destabilize Ethiopia's constitutional order.

name: UN OCHA / UNHCR Spokesperson
role: United Nations humanitarian agencies tracking displacement from the Shererina clashes and coordinating the 2026 Sudan Regional Refugee Response Plan covering Ethiopia and six neighboring countries
quote: We are gravely concerned for the safety of refugees and newly displaced civilians caught between the fighting near the Sudanese border.

name: Amnesty International Spokesperson
role: Human rights organization that documented renewed risk to Tigray residents following the August 1, 2026 clashes and has tracked drone-strike civilian harm across Amhara and Tigray through 2026
quote: Renewed violence puts civilians in Tigray at serious risk of human rights violations. Both parties must take all feasible precautions to protect them.
